_doc: Command guard for tmux-mcp.mjs. Screens run_command always, and send_keys whenever it submits a line (enter:true / Enter key / newline in text). `deny`: glob patterns matched ANYWHERE in the command — a match always blocks. `allow`: glob patterns matched against the FULL command — when non-empty, run_command only accepts matching commands (send_keys is exempt from the allowlist so REPL/TUI input keeps working; '*' matches any text). Re-read on every call: edits apply immediately, no restart. If this file is missing or invalid, the server falls back to a built-in copy of this deny list. Note: this is an accident-net, not a hard security boundary — judge it accordingly.
